best: Every sheet is split into titled functional blocks with a clear left-to-right power path (3V3 buck, pack fuse-FET path, four-switch stage with sense filters above the shunts) and thorough numbered notes.
worst: Reference/value text collides with net labels and neighbouring parts in many places (CELL_4P/R119, FET_MID/R106, PACK_P/R113, RS101/TP109, R444, GAUGE_FUSE on pin 25, adjacent bulk-cap values, stacked GND pin numbers on U401/U405).
Gauge and charger IC inputs are reached by dense staircase wire bundles with floating ground symbols and bare TS2/TS3 stubs, and long CHG/DSG gate wires run across the Cells sheet.

Uneven use of space: 3V3 sheet uses under half the page, Cells sheet has a sparse left-bottom and a cramped gauge input cluster; switch FETs are drawn as split boxes and the antenna match is not a textbook pi.
